question: kilowatt hour (kW.h) is a unit of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**energy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• A kilowatt hour (kW.h) is a unit of **energy**.
 
• It is commonly used to measure electrical energy consumption.
 
• One kilowatt hour is equivalent to the energy consumption of a 1000-watt appliance running for one hour.
 
• The kilowatt hour is a derived unit of energy in the International System of Units (SI).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Energy:** The capacity to do work, measured in joules (J) in the SI system, but kilowatt hours (kW.h) are used for practical electrical energy measurement.
 
• **Power:** The rate at which energy is used or transferred, measured in watts (W). 1 watt = 1 joule per second.
 
• **Joule:** The SI unit of energy, defined as the energy transferred when applying a force of one newton over a distance of one meter.
 
• **Electricity Billing:** Household electricity bills typically use kilowatt hours to quantify energy consumption.
 
• **Conversion:** 1 kilowatt hour = 3.6 million joules (3.6 x 10⁶ J).
